objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the race condition weakness of a router administration panel (Flask, MySQL) whose admin pages check authentication and authorization and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Look at what happens between the authorization check and the action it protects.
The application ships with a demo account; its README or login page may tell you more.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which class of flaw lets a check and its use be separated in time?

answer: time of check time of use

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: What is the name of the flaw where a check is made at one time and relied on later?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness gives you a first account without registering?
